name: Promise Toast
description: One toast that follows one async job: a hairline while it loads, a morph in place to success or error, and an Undo whose ring counts down. Pauses on hover.

props.name: job
props.description: The async work. Resolve for success, reject for error. Runs on mount and whenever runKey changes. Left out, the toast settles as success at once.

props.name: runKey
props.description: Change it to run the job again. The toast morphs back to loading.

props.name: loadingTitle
props.description: Title while the job is in flight.

props.name: loadingDescription
props.description: Line under the title while loading.

props.name: successTitle
props.description: Title once the job resolves.

props.name: successDescription
props.description: Line under the success title. With undo on, the undo window is appended, e.g. “· 5 s to undo”.

props.name: retryLabel
props.description: Label on the quiet Retry button. It appears on error only when onRetry is set.

props.name: errorTitle
props.description: Title if the job rejects.

props.name: errorDescription
props.default: "Nothing was archived. Your inbox is unchanged."
props.description: Line under the error title. Say what state the world is in now.

props.name: undoLabel
props.description: Label on the Undo button.

props.name: undoTitle
props.description: Title once Undo has been pressed. The toast then leaves on its own.

props.name: undoneDescription
props.description: Line under the restored title.

props.name: undo
props.description: Offer Undo on success. The ring around the button counts the window down.

props.name: duration
props.description: The success window in seconds (2 to 10). The toast leaves when it ends, with Undo or without it. With Undo on, the ring counts it down.

props.name: position
props.description: Where the toast sits. On phones it always spans the bottom (or top) edge.

props.name: strategy
props.description: Absolute fills the nearest positioned parent; fixed pins to the viewport.

props.name: theme
props.description: The surface the toast sits on. Its ink, tracks and shadow follow it.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Runs when Undo is pressed. Put the change back here.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Runs when Retry is pressed on an error, just before the job runs again. Without it there is no Retry button.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Runs when the toast leaves: the countdown ended, it was swiped or dismissed, or Esc was pressed.

props.name: outcome
props.description: Demo only. What the demo job settles with. Changing it replays the job.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Demo only. Which job the toast follows: archive the 12 threads, or snooze the 5 shown.
